company.name: Sennder
company.shortDescription: Sennder is a digital freight-forwarding company that specializes in connecting shippers with carriers for full truckload (FTL) services.
company.description: Sennder is a digital road freight forwarder that links commercial shippers with freight carriers. It provides automation, transparency, and efficiency with its in-house-developed platform for the freight market. They digitalize the truckload-shipping ecosystem by providing mobile apps to drivers, fleet management tools to carrier managers, and logistics management solutions to shippers. The company offers real-time booking as well as precise live tracking, bringing full transparency to any logistics supply chain. It integrates directly with the shippers’ transport management and freight management systems via APIs and by cutting the multiple middlemen, it increases efficiency and reduces cost for all stakeholders.
